# Awakening Cave Pixel Assets (`dist/assets/awakening/`)

Handcrafted pixel sprites aligned in tone saturation, subtle crevice shading (`avgSat ~0.31`), and ~30° 3/4 scale directly with `huyen-bao-travel.png`, `central-gu-master.png`, and `world/bamboo.png`.

- **`nguyet-lan-tiles.png`** (`128×32`, 4 variants `32×32`, binary alpha, bottom-center anchored `(16, 31)`):
  - Variant 0: Upright twin crescent Moon Orchids on slender curving jade stalk
  - Variant 1: Low spreading riverbank leaf carpet with dual blossoms
  - Variant 2: Wind-bent sweeping raceme
  - Variant 3: Compact budding young rosette
- **`hy-vong-gu.png`** (`64×16`, 4 flight frames `16×16`, binary alpha):
  - Delicate luminous lantern-firefly sprite (wing upstroke -> wide glide -> swept pulse -> lift recovery)
- **`awakening-preview.png`**: Visual comparison & in-scene composite directly beside `huyen-bao-travel.png` and `world/bamboo.png` on dark limestone cave rock.
- **`awakening-assets.json`**: Frame, anchor, and variant metadata.
